mime_sniff_validated.evidence: LogoUploadValidator(image_bytes) is invoked in apps/siteconfig/tenant_studio_day1.py::accept_logo_upload; the validator sniffs magic bytes (PNG 89 50 4E 47, JPEG FF D8 FF, WebP RIFF+WEBP) and rejects SVG via the same path. Tests test_pdf_disguised_as_png_rejected_via_mime_sniff (service) and test_pdf_disguised_as_png_rejected_via_mime_sniff (view) prove a renamed PDF with content_type=image/png is still rejected with error_code=unsupported_mime.

csrf_protected.evidence: TenantStudioDay1Act1LogoUploadView has no csrf_exempt decorator (verifier regex check); the partial emits {% csrf_token %} inside the upload form; the JS sends X-CSRFToken in fetch headers + csrfmiddlewaretoken in FormData. The verifier explicitly fails if @csrf_exempt or method_decorator(csrf_exempt) appears in the views module.

tenant_isolation_proof.request_resolution: school = getattr(request, 'school', None); no POST-body school resolution anywhere in TenantStudioDay1Act1LogoUploadView
tenant_isolation_proof.storage_keying: _persist_day1_logo_bytes() builds storage_path = tenant_media_path(school.pk, 'brand/logo.{ext}') — keyed strictly on the request-resolved school.pk
tests: test_tenant_isolation_school_resolved_from_request_not_post_body (view) — sends school_id=attacker-tenant in POST body; asserts bytes land under real-tenant only

pii_clean.evidence: School slug hashed to sha256[:8] via _school_log_label() before any logger call; original_filename never logged; file bytes never logged; size and sniffed MIME logged only.

atomic_transaction.evidence: Day1MagicService.accept_logo_upload wraps school.save(update_fields=['branding_metadata', 'logo_url']) + branding_metadata mutation inside `with transaction.atomic():`
